name: Services MUST undergo mandatory assurance thru DSAM to ensure critical risks are detected and managed effectively.
requirementTitle: Services MUST undergo mandatory assurance thru DSAM to ensure critical risks are detected and managed effectively.
requirementDescription: Before a service can proceed through key stages of its lifecycle it must go through the DSAM assurance process so that significant risks are identified, assessed, and addressed.
why:
Without assurance, teams may unintentionally introduce:
- Security vulnerabilities
- Unsupported technologies
- Compliance issues
- Single points of failure
- Poor operational processes
A formal assurance process provides an independent review and challenge before those issues affect production services.
